title: Pentaho Data Integration in 2 Hours
description: A hands-on, try-and-buy lab: build a real pipeline with Pentaho Data Integration Developer Edition — from first preview to change history and metadata injection — in one two-hour sitting.

assistant.subject: Pentaho Data Integration (Spoon, transformations, jobs)
suggestions: What is a transformation vs a job?
How do I preview data at any step?
What does the Dimension Lookup/Update step do?
What is metadata injection used for?

trial.label: Get the full Pentaho platform trial

moduleSummaries.title: Get Ready
moduleSummaries.summary: Ten minutes before the clock starts: check your machine, start the sample database, and confirm PDI opens. Nothing in the two hours is spent on setup.

moduleSummaries.title: See It Work
moduleSummaries.summary: Open a finished pipeline and watch it run in your first ten minutes — then build the same thing yourself and understand every step you clicked.

moduleSummaries.title: Make It Yours
moduleSummaries.summary: Join JSON and CSV sources on one canvas, then load a warehouse table that tracks every historical change — the work that normally takes a page of SQL, done with two configured steps.

moduleSummaries.title: See It Scale
moduleSummaries.summary: One template transformation ingests files of different shapes, driven by a control file — then swap in a file of your own data and watch the same pipeline handle it.

moduleSummaries.title: Make It Real
moduleSummaries.summary: What production looks like: scheduling, monitoring, clustering, lineage — and what moving from Developer Edition to a licensed deployment actually involves.
